Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking our onboarding. We need to get DataProc set up in your procurement portal (Coupa) and finalize the MSA and Order Form so we can start issuing POs by the end of June. I attached our internal redline (DP_MSA_Redline_20270610.pdf) to highlight the two sticking points: data retention length and indemnity carve-outs.

- What specific signer information do you need for Redwood to create a vendor record in Coupa? (name, title, email, bank details, tax id, certificate of insurance)

Hi Linda — thanks for the redline, and welcome. I’m looping in Monica from Onboarding and Markus from Legal to review the MSA/Order Form comments and confirm portal onboarding steps.

Quick answers first:
- Signer info: full name, title, email, phone, company tax ID (TIN/VAT), ACH + remittance instructions (if you want auto-pay), and COI (certificate of insurance) are helpful.
- PO ACK SLA: our standard is 72 hours for PO acknowledgement; for some enterprise customers we can tighten to 48 hrs with an SLA addendum. EDI ACK is optional but recommended if you’ll be automating invoices. Monica will outline the fields we map in Coupa.

Next steps:
1) Markus will send redline feedback on the MSA and Order Form.
2) Monica will send a Coupa onboarding checklist and request KYC docs.
3) If legal changes are material, we can run a short canary: order form + provisional vendor record while legal finalizes the MSA.

I’m available for a 30-min sync Friday afternoon PT if useful — propose 3pm PT.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal registration + contract redlines for MSA & PO

Linda / Aisha — I reviewed DP_MSA_Redline_20270610.pdf and drafted a focused redline for the Order Form (OrderForm_V1_Redlined.docx). High-level items:

1) Indemnity: DataProc’s proposed broad carve-out for third-party claims is too open. Two practical options:
   a) Redwood accepts a limited carve-out only for claims arising from DataProc’s gross negligence or willful misconduct; or
   b) If DataProc insists on broader language, we require reciprocal indemnities for Redwood customers and an explicit cap tied to the annual contract value for Order Form claims.

2) Data retention & deletion: Your redline shortens our standard retention for telemetry logs. We can agree to a 90-day retention for raw logs with a three-year retention for aggregated telemetry used for billing disputes, provided access controls are enforced and a data export mechanism is documented in the Order Form.

3) PO acknowledgement & invoicing: We need the Order Form to specify the ACK window (72 hrs by default) and whether EDI 997 ACKs are part of the flow. If you require sub-24 hour ACKs, that needs an operational SLA and financial remedy.

I’ve attached the OrderForm_V1_Redlined.docx with inline comments. For speed, if DataProc can accept Option (a) on indemnity and the 90/3y retention split, we can proceed with portal provisioning immediately and roll the final MSA signature to DocuSign after we align the last few clauses.

- Markus Klein
General Counsel (Contracts) | Redwood Inference
Attachment: OrderForm_V1_Redlined.docx

Hi Linda — Monica from Onboarding here.

We can start vendor provisioning in Coupa while legal finalizes the MSA redlines; below is the checklist and required fields so your procurement team can prepare a single package:

Required for vendor profile creation (Coupa):
- Legal business name
- DBA (if applicable)
- Tax ID / VAT ID
- Primary contact (name, title, email, phone)
- Remittance details (ACH routing or wire instructions)
- COI (certificate of insurance) PDF

PO & EDI mapping notes:
- PO number: our system requires a top-level PO number (string) — this is mandatory.
- PO acknowledgement window: 72 hours default.
- EDI: we accept 850/810 flows; if you want automated ACKs (997) please indicate and provide test EDI endpoint.
- Invoice matching: 3-way by default (PO/receipt/invoice). If you cannot provide receipts via EDI, please confirm manual matching tolerance.

Attachments we typically exchange:
- Coupa_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (attached)
- Standard W-9 or W-8BEN (if US/non-US)

If you can send those items and confirm whether you’ll accept Markus’ Option (a) on indemnity, we’ll create a provisional vendor profile and enable portal access for PO receipt/testing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Coupa_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx
